thread:
olivia.peopleops: Hey team — urgent: employee's specialty pharmacy won't dispense an anti-nausea infusion without a physical card. They billed today and claim PH-704 denied OON citing billing entity mismatch. We have PA-4477. Need a temp digital ID to present at pickup and guidance to get the claim reprocessed in-network.

mark.benefits: We can issue a temporary proof-of-coverage PDF (informational only) with member name, masked ID, plan (Redwood Core PPO), group, coverage dates, and list PA-4477. That usually lets pharmacies process.

jess.hr: Also want the exact wording the pharmacy should use when resubmitting so they don't resubmit with same billing TIN/NPI.

pharm-liaison: Pharmacies often bill under distributor TIN. Ask them to resubmit using the contracted dispensing provider NPI and include PA-4477 in claim remarks. Suggested note: "Reprocess claim PH-704: Prior Authorization PA-4477 applies; correct billing provider NPI/TIN to contracted dispensing provider on file; denial due to provider credential mismatch. Attach PA documentation and itemized invoice."

olivia.peopleops: @benefits-bot can you generate the short temp ID text we can email the pharmacy now?

benefits-bot: Draft temporary proof-of-coverage (informational only): "Redwood Inference — Temporary Proof of Coverage. Member: [NAME]. Member ID: [MASKED]. Group: RED-502. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Coverage: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior Auth: PA-4477 (supportive infusion). For claim inquiries call insurer provider relations 1-800-555-0199 or submit via provider portal. This is not a guarantee of payment. Please confirm billing provider NPI/TIN matches insurer provider file before submission."

mark.benefits: Good. I'll file an insurer escalation when the pharmacy confirms resubmission and attach PA-4477 + EOB. If insurer denies again, escalate to medical appeals with infusion order and clinical notes.

jess.hr: Thanks — I'll send the PDF and resubmission script to the employee and copy the pharmacy. Will update when they respond. :white_check_mark:
